device_class: modern flagship-class smartphone main camera, natural computational photography
focus: single-point autofocus locked on the refrigerator body; keep the complete product sharp enough for documentation
exposure: neutral indoor exposure around -0.1 EV; preserve dark-surface detail without lifted HDR shadows
lighting: soft natural window daylight from camera-right plus weak ambient room fill; no studio flash
stabilization: normal handheld optical/electronic stabilization; no artificial motion blur
processing: natural smartphone JPEG/HEIC look with restrained HDR, neutral sharpening, realistic micro-contrast and no beauty/product-ad retouching
realism_rules: retain subtle sensor-like texture and ordinary household contrast
avoid perfectly clean CGI gradients and mirror-smooth surfaces
keep vertical edges believable and avoid ultra-wide stretching
use realistic contact shadows and small imperfect reflections
